title: Nonnegativity of the noise kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho$ be a real number with $0 \le \rho \le 1$. Then for all points $x, y$ of the Boolean hypercube $\mathrm{BoolCube}\,n$, the noise kernel is nonnegative: $K_\rho(x, y) \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: x, y arbitrary points of the n-dimensional Boolean hypercube
